name: Supported Headstand
description: Inversion balancing on the forearms and the crown of the head.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Kneel and set your forearms down, clasping your hands with your elbows shoulder-width apart.
Rest the crown of your head on the floor with the back of it against your hands. Learn this with a teacher.

keyframes.name: Dolphin
keyframes.cue: Forearms down, lift the hips high.

keyframes.name: Supported Headstand
keyframes.cue: Interlace the hands behind the head, walk in, and lift the legs.

cues: Most weight goes in the forearms.
